plan.title: M5Stack Atom-Matrix v1.1 · C008-B-V11
plan.summary: ESP32-PICO-D4 控制器，配 5×5 RGB LED 阵列、BMI270、按键、红外和 USB-C/Grove 扩展。
limitations: No physical hardware measurements; colors are photograph-informed approximations, not calibrated materials.
PCB has no audited complete board layout and is represented only by a visible neutral UNKNOWN placeholder.
Original source plastic depth13.8mm differs from official13.9mm. Difference retained; no scaling.
v1.1 IMU is BMI270, not older MPU6886.
Paper/optical projection is isolated from molded shell; small printed markings and hidden hardware not supplied by source CAD may remain incomplete.
25 optical spots are driven by guest G27 RMT; photograph colors are not rendered as firmware output. Diffusion/brightness remain approximate.
plan.assemblyNotes: Original manufacturer components selected from assembled cluster; other components excluded with reasons. One rigid global transform, no scaling.

omittedComponents.reason: Separate print-layout duplicate; excluded from assembled cluster.

buttons.notes: Front diffuser is the documented pushbutton, not a touchscreen; plane above optical lit-area surfaces.

unknowns.notes: Explicit capacity not stated in audited specification; null does not mean zero.

unknowns.notes: No pinned binary/layout/hash verified. Software documentation remains linked in source records.

facts.label: Paper and optical face isolation
facts.value: Only manually selected original photograph paper/glass ROIs are retained. All molded shell areas, screws, ports, keys and live displays are excluded from photograph projection.
facts.method: Fixed original-pixel masks and independent mm planes; source images are unmodified except alpha and crop. Recess plane selected from manufacturer CAD planar-face audit.
facts.uncertainty: Paper boundary +/-0.3mm; optical cover diameter +/-0.5mm. Printed-paper images do not establish calibrated optics or firmware output.

front.basis: Independent official silhouette sets camera scale/center only; source geometry unchanged.

textureSources.notes: Original-pixel paper ROI only; excluded shell/ports/hardware remain separately materialized.
